title.en: An Act Amending Section Six of Act Numbered Seventeen Hundred and Sixty, Permitting Provincial Boards to Intervene in the Prevention of the Spread of Dangerous Communicable Animal Diseases Within the Islands.

text.en:
Section six of Act Numbered Seventeen hundred and sixty is hereby amended by adding at the
end thereof the following paragraph:
"(g) The Director of Agriculture shall prescribe all necessary measures to enforce the provisions of the
foregoing provincial governor. subsections (c), (d), and (e), and the provincial governor of the province
concerned shall have the direction of and be responsible for the enforcement of the measures so prescribed."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and forty-five of the Philippine
Legislature.
Enacted, December 13, 1913.
